statBlock.name: Brass Dragon Wyrmling
statBlock.description: Mottled brown scales and a broad plate across its forehead mark this wyrmling. It seeks heat, sunshine, and conversation.

sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.
Breath Weapons (recharge 5–6). Choose one breath.
Fire Breath. Each creature in a 20-ft. line that is 5 ft. wide makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 14 (4d6) fire damage. On a success, it takes half.
Sleep Breath. Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 11 Constitution save. On a failure, it falls Unconscious for 1 minute. Taking damage or having another creature use an action to wake it ends the effect.

statBlock.name: Bronze Dragon Wyrmling
statBlock.description: This coastal wyrmling has webbed feet, yellow-green scales, and a ridged crest.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The wyrmling can breathe air and water.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.
Breath Weapons (recharge 5–6). Choose one breath.
Lightning Breath. Each creature in a 40-ft. line that is 5 ft. wide makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 16 (3d10) lightning damage. On a success, it takes half.
Repulsion Breath. Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 12 Strength save. On a failure, it is pushed 30 ft. away from the dragon.

statBlock.name: Copper Dragon Wyrmling
statBlock.description: This rocky upland wyrmling likes jokes and riddles. It prizes metal and gems.

sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.
Breath Weapons (recharge 5–6). Choose one breath.
Acid Breath. Each creature in a 20-ft. line that is 5 ft. wide makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 18 (4d8) acid damage. On a success, it takes half.
Slowing Breath. Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 11 Constitution save. On a failure, for 1 minute it loses its reactions, its speed is halved, and on its turn it can make at most one attack. On each of those turns, it can use at most one action or bonus action. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

statBlock.name: Gold Dragon Wyrmling
statBlock.description: Metal flecks show in the wyrmling’s dark yellow scales. Long whiskers frame its face.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The wyrmling can breathe air and water.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.
Breath Weapons (recharge 5–6). Choose one breath.
Fire Breath. Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 13 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 22 (4d10) fire damage. On a success, it takes half.
Weakening Breath. Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 13 Strength save. On a failure, it has disadvantage on Strength-based attack rolls, Strength checks, and Strength saves for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 115. The official errata corrects the Constitution save to +5.

statBlock.name: Silver Dragon Wyrmling
statBlock.description: Silver highlights mark this wyrmling’s blue-gray scales. A spiny crest runs from its head down its back.

sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.
Breath Weapons (recharge 5–6). Choose one breath.
Cold Breath. Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 18 (4d8) cold damage. On a success, it takes half.
Paralyzing Breath. Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure, it is Paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
